name: Prune Jelly
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Essence of vanilla or juice and rind of a lemon

instructions.text: Boil slowly till soft in sufficient water to cover
Add essence of vanilla, or if preferred the juice and rind of a lemon, and the juice of two oranges

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash the prunes
2. Boil slowly till soft in sufficient water to cover
3. Take out the stones
4. Sweeten to taste
5. Add essence of vanilla, or if preferred the juice and rind of a lemon, and the juice of two oranges
6. Soak the gelatine till soft
7. Add the above, stir all well together
8. Pour into a mould and let stand till it is very cold
